asm-no-end.reason: ASM88 only warns when END is missing; SIM88 makes it an error (decision 6 in PROGRESS.md).

hand-printer-polling.reason: MSX88 prints one character every 5 seconds of wall clock, so BUSY is still 1 after the 4th character; how many instructions run meanwhile depends on the host (exp-printer-seconds, exp-printer-speed). SIM88 prints one character every N instructions (Options › Frequencies), the same on every run.
